structured_output.title: Service account template boolean annotations fix applies to upgrade path
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and is upgrading to v1.18.0, where this service account template fix is included. The fix addresses boolean-valued annotations in cert-manager's service account templates. Inspect your cert-manager Helm values and deployed manifests for any boolean-type annotations (e.g., `mykey: true` rather than `mykey: "true"`) that might depend on proper template rendering. The evidence does not specify which annotations or scenarios are affected, so review the PR #7698 for details.
